### Findings
This analysis measures item volume grouped by product for items with status `Complete` across all available records, scoped to authorized products (products 1 and 2) via executor-bound views [q1]. No date filter was applied.

| product_id | complete_items |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1 | 7 |
| 2 | 7 |

Each authorized product has 7 completed items recorded in the dataset [q1].

### Limitations
- The query only counted completed item records; it did not return distinct order counts, customer counts, or revenue metrics [q1].
- No date filter was applied, and dataset date range coverage or completeness was not measured [q1].

### Action items (proposed)
- What is the total completed revenue (`SUM(sale_price)`) and distinct order count (`COUNT(DISTINCT order_key)`) for each product?
- How are these completed items distributed by month or year across the available history?
